column3: NASB adds “Now it will come about that”; “at the head of the mountains” is rendered “as the chief of the mountains.”
NASB supplies “influences” in “filled with influences from the east,” and renders “clap hands with” as “strike bargains with.”
“Everyone … everyone” is rendered “the common man … the man of importance.”
The clause “to the moles and the bats” is moved forward in the verse.
“Cease from man” is rendered “Stop regarding man,” and NASB adds “of life” to “breath.”
